Record Class Arena

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.cuseto.pong.game.model.Arena
Record Components:
width - the arena's total width, boundary walls included; must be positive, and must leave a positive inner width after both side walls are subtracted
height - the arena's total height, boundary walls included; must be positive, and must leave a positive inner height after both walls are subtracted
anchorX - the x-coordinate of the arena's top-left corner on screen; must not be negative
anchorY - the y-coordinate of the arena's top-left corner on screen; must not be negative
boundaryThickness - the thickness of each boundary wall; must be positive
public record Arena(int width, int height, int anchorX, int anchorY, int boundaryThickness) extends Record
Represents the rectangular playing field, including its boundary walls.

width and height describe the arena's full outer dimensions, boundary walls included, anchored at (anchorX, anchorY) on screen. The playable area is the region inside the walls, exposed via innerWidth(), innerHeight(), and the inner*Boundary accessors.

    • Arena

      public Arena(int width, int height, int anchorX, int anchorY, int boundaryThickness)
      Validates the record components.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if width, height, or boundaryThickness is not positive; if anchorX or anchorY is negative; if the boundaries leave no positive inner width or height; or if the arena's far edge would exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE
